key_insight: ONAM decomposes black-box predictions into structured feature effects with hierarchical orthogonality, making the components identifiable and uniquely defined.
engineering_relevance: The model-agnostic R package supports post-hoc interpretation of prediction models through effect visualizations and quantitative interpretability measures.
method: Apply functional decomposition to black-box predictions.
Fit structured components associated with input features.
Enforce hierarchical orthogonality to identify components uniquely.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports mathematical foundations, algorithmic design, and software architecture, but provides no datasets or quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Practical decomposition fidelity and computational cost should be evaluated for the target model and dataset.
paper_title: ONAM: Fitting Orthogonal Neural Additive Models for Post-Hoc Interpretability of Black-Box Predictions
